newsitem.title: USA: Waste Management to construct Ill. facility.
newsitem.headline: Waste Management to construct Ill. facility.

text.p: Waste Management Inc said it signed an agreement to design, construct and operate a regional disposal facility for Will County, Illinois.
The company said it expects revenues over the life of the contract of $400 million.
In a release dated July 8, the company said the contract, which was awarded on a competitive bid basis, was approved by the County Board in late May and was signed in June.
The planned site will have a 14 million ton capacity, and will acccept about 2,000 tons of waste a day for an estimated 23 years.
